title: Safety Committee Guide: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
audience: Joint safety committee and workforce representatives
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: The two top-rated findings sit at supervision and organisational level, not with the crew.

items.text: After a seal change, a pump was restarted without a leak test [FND-0001].

sections.heading: What the investigation says about the system

items.lesson: The job had no checklist to catch a skipped test.
items.explanation: The procedure index has no return-to-service entry [EVD-0002].

items.question: Who may stop a restart when the test record is missing?
items.why: The restart went ahead without one.

sections.heading: What to look for on site

items.text: Is there a leak-test record on the last pump work order?
Ground rules: no names, no blame, talk about conditions.
Ask to see the new return-to-service checklist.
Ask for the share of restarts with a test record.
